title: Saints rookie WR Jordyn Tyson reportedly expected to miss about 2 months due to training camp hamstring injury

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Saints rookie WR Jordyn Tyson reportedly expected to miss about 2 months due to training camp hamstring injury
sources.description: Tyson had hamstring issues last year at Arizona State, but New Orleans head coach Kellen Moore told reporters that the wideout's latest setback isn't related to his injury history.
